prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: full-bleed dashboard background raster, landscape 8:5 composition, intended final delivery at 1920×1200 or nearest generated landscape size.
Input image: the supplied approved APU login comp is a STYLE AND COMPOSITION REFERENCE ONLY. Preserve its archival Bolivian survey-map visual language—mineral paper, engraved contour density, ink restraint, and route/river/ridgeline palette—but do not reproduce any of its text, branding, form UI, border labels, numeric labels, stamp, legend, or controls.
Primary request: create one continuous Bolivian-inspired topographic survey-map field spanning edge to edge. The left 60% contains a dense dramatic Andean mountain mass built from hundreds of fine, hand-engraved contour lines, subtle hachure shading, nested ridges, ravines, and valley folds. The right 40% transitions naturally into a much quieter open contour field with broad low-density lines and generous usable negative space for a dashboard interface overlay. It must still read as one continuous map, not two panels.
Style/medium: late-20th-century Bolivian cartographic survey sheet, refined pen-and-ink engraving on tactile mineral paper; authentic, quiet, precise, premium; flat orthographic map artwork, no perspective scene.
Color palette: warm mineral paper base #F3EBD8; contour ink deep muted forest/charcoal green; very restrained thin river network in oxidized blue; selective mineral-red ridgelines; one surveying-yellow dashed route starting in the left mountain field and meandering continuously toward the lower-right edge.
Materials/textures: subtle fibrous paper grain and faint age variation, evenly restrained, no stains that compromise legibility.
Composition/framing: full bleed, no decorative outer frame; highest topographic density on the left and lower-left; calm open field across upper-right and right-center; the yellow route is visually secondary but clearly traceable and exits toward lower-right. River and route may cross naturally. Tiny coordinate ticks and technical cross marks may appear only as non-text geometry.
Text: none.
Constraints: background asset only; no APU wordmark; no logos; no login form; no panels; no buttons; no inputs; no human-readable labels; no letters; no numbers; no symbols that resemble badges or branding; no claims; no people; no buildings; no political boundaries; no UI controls; no watermark. Avoid gradients, photorealistic terrain, satellite imagery, 3D relief, modern GIS neon styling, grid overlays, compass roses, stamps, legends, and scale bars. Keep all interface text semantic in code.
